story_title: As Technical Support Staff, I want to release or adjust an equipment reservation so that reserved quantities match what the event now needs and unneeded equipment is free for other events

acceptance_criteria.text: Technical Support Staff can release an equipment reservation for an event.
Technical Support Staff can reduce the reserved quantity of a reservation.
Technical Support Staff can increase the reserved quantity, and the system prevents an increase beyond the quantity available for the event's dates.
Given a reservation is released or reduced, when availability is next checked, then the freed quantity is available for overlapping events.
The fulfilment status of the related equipment requirement is updated to reflect the change (see: Review and Update Equipment Request).
The assigned Event Coordinator is notified when a reservation for their event is released or adjusted.

Given the Event Coordinator changes an equipment requirement that already has a reservation, when the change is saved, then the requirement goes back to Technical Support Staff as Requested, showing the quantity already reserved, for them to review again; the reservation is not changed automatically and is not flagged.
A released reservation remains on the event record and is distinguishable from an active reservation.

test_cases.title: Technical Support releases a reservation after first cancelling, the line is marked Released, and its units become available to an overlapping event
test_cases.preconditions:
Both events are on 13 Jun 2028 and use Wireless Presenter (4 in stock):
- SPM69 Release Rehearsal: 3 requested, 3 reserved (Status 'Reserved')
- SPM69 Overlap Seminar: 3 requested, nothing reserved
Data: run `npm run fixtures:spm69` first. Go straight on to SPM-69-TC02, and run the script again after it.
Logged in as Technical Support Staff (vikram.nair@connectsphere.com, password123).
steps: Open the equipment request for the SPM69 Overlap Seminar event
Open the equipment request for the SPM69 Release Rehearsal event
On the Wireless Presenter line, click 'Release'
On the Wireless Presenter line, click 'Release' again
Open the equipment request for the SPM69 Overlap Seminar event
test_cases.test_data:
Released: SPM69 Release Rehearsal, Wireless Presenter (3 reserved)
Overlapping event: SPM69 Overlap Seminar, Wireless Presenter (3 requested)
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: The Wireless Presenter line reads '4 total − 0 out of service − 3 reserved elsewhere = 1 available for these dates' and '3 requested, 1 available.' Its Availability chip shows 'Partial'.
Step 4: The Wireless Presenter line shows Requested 3, Reserved 3 and Status 'Reserved', with 'Adjust' and 'Release' buttons and no 'Reserve' button.
Step 5: A dialog 'Release this reservation?' appears, saying 'This frees the 3 Wireless Presenter reserved for SPM69 Release Rehearsal for other events. The event's Coordinator is told.'
Step 6: The dialog closes. The line still shows Reserved 3 and Status 'Reserved'.
Step 8: The dialog closes and 'Reservation released.' appears on the line. Its Status chip shows 'Released', the Reserved column shows '—', and the line says 'Released — 3 were reserved.' 'Adjust' and 'Release' are no longer offered; 'Reserve' is.
Step 10: The Wireless Presenter line now reads '4 total − 0 out of service − 0 reserved elsewhere = 4 available for these dates' and its Availability chip shows 'Available'.

open_questions: DECIDED 2026-10-22 (kchoongg) - a reservation can never be more than the quantity the Coordinator requested (TC05). Technical Support matches the requirement; to need more, the Coordinator changes it first (AC7). Not in the story's wording.

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (kchoongg) - releasing and adjusting are allowed only while the event is in Planning, the same window as Reserve (SPM-49) and Update (SPM-50). On a Confirmed event the equipment is final and a change goes through a change request (TC09).

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (kchoongg) - a released line keeps its quantity as the record of what it held ('Released — 3 were reserved.' on the Equipment request page, '3 released' on the Coordinator's Equipment tab) and holds no stock. Reserve is offered on it again, so the reservation can be made again if the event needs it after all (TC01).

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (kchoongg) - a requirement sent back by the Coordinator (AC7) keeps its reserved units counted against availability until Technical Support acts on it: adjusts, releases, reserves again, or marks it 'Cannot be provided'. That is how 'the reservation is not changed automatically' is built.

DECIDED 2026-10-22 (kchoongg) - screen wording, chosen to match the Reserve and Update panels: buttons 'Adjust' and 'Release'; field 'Reserved quantity'; dialog 'Release this reservation?'; confirmations 'Reservation changed: N reserved.' and 'Reservation released.'; refusals 'Only N available for this event's dates.', 'The event requested N — a reservation cannot be more than that.', 'Enter a whole number of at least 1. To free all of it, use Release.', 'That is already the reserved quantity.'; notifications 'Equipment reservation released' / 'Equipment reservation changed'; AC7 note 'The Coordinator changed this requirement — N still reserved. Review it again.'

OPEN - a released line still counts as an outstanding equipment arrangement when the Coordinator confirms the event or submits it for a safety check (only 'cancelled' lines are skipped in src/lib/eventConfirmation.ts and safetyCheck.ts). So after a release, the Coordinator must remove the requirement or mark it not required before confirming. This seems right, since the requirement is no longer met, but the team should confirm it.

OPEN - recording units out of service (SPM-55) flags only Reserved and Partially fulfilled lines whose reservation is now short. A line sent back to Technical Support (AC7) that still holds units is not flagged. Technical Support is reviewing that line anyway, so this was left as it is.

OPEN - no notification goes to Technical Support when a requirement comes back as Requested (AC7). The story only says it goes back to them; it shows on their Equipment request page with the note above.
